title: Intermediate state of the doubling pass
statement: For every finite bit string $x$, every $j\le |x|$, and the corresponding bound hypothesis $j\le |x|$, after $2j$ steps from its initial configuration on input $x$, the duplicator is in its scanning state at input position $j$ and its output consists of each of the first $j$ bits of $x$ written twice.
replaced:
For every $j \le \abs{x}$, after $2j$ steps from its initial configuration on
input $x$ the duplicator is in its scanning state at input position $j$ and
has emitted each of the first $j$ bits of $x$ twice.
